extractions.description: Introduces and evaluates StarCoderBase and StarCoder, develops StarEncoder and a PII-detection model, curates code-training data, and releases code-model evaluation and attribution tooling.

type.quote: We trained StarCoderBase on 1 trillion tokens sourced from 80+ programming languages, GitHub issues, Git commits, and Jupyter notebooks. We fine-tuned StarCoderBase on another 35B Python tokens, leading to the StarCoder model.
type.justification: The work trains, fine-tunes, and empirically evaluates learned models.
